description: AARIS synthetic fleet profiles for the SIH demo. ALL aircraft identities, maintenance dates, issue logs and report histories in this file are SYNTHETIC demonstration data. No real Indian Air Force maintenance records, tail numbers, sortie data, defect reports, classified or operational information is used, scraped, inferred, or implied.

data_provenance.rul_model: NASA C-MAPSS (public run-to-failure dataset, FD001) — see docs/RESULTS.md
data_provenance.images: Per-type illustrative reference photos (dashboard/assets/plane_types/). They depict the aircraft TYPE only — not the specific fictional airframe — and carry no association to any real tail number, base or record.
